title: Stars and crosses of the new courtyard, Mashhad
subtitle: The new courtyard, Mashhad

construction.changes: Wichmann draws the design turned by 45°; it is turned here so that the tile is the square cell. The compass steps, their order and the named points are ours. The comparison with the drawing checks the finished lines, not how the design was first laid out. No photo of the wall was checked.
construction.note: The finished design was read from Brian Wichmann’s F82 drawing, its corners snapped to exact values. It has every line of the Atabaki court design of Qom (F77), inked another way, so it uses the same construction. The drawing gives no steps.

credits.source: Tiling Search, data16/F82: Mashhad, the new courtyard
credits.note: The design was read from his drawing. He takes it from Mahmood Maher al-Naqsh, Design and execution of drawing in Iranian tilework, Islamic period, Reza Abbasi Museum, 1983, figure 82, page 40 (the new courtyard, Mashhad). The construction is ours.
credits.creator: Brian Wichmann

given.O: The centre of an eight-pointed star.
given.A: Halfway from O to the next star on the horizontal line.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.

Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through each of A and B. Draw a horizontal line through each of C and D. These lines make the square cell, with corners K1, K2, K3 and K4. Draw a straight line through O and K1.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through A. Draw a horizontal line through C. They cross at K1, a corner of the cell. Draw a straight line through O and K1.

steps.text: Draw a circle with centre A through O. It crosses the first circle at E. Draw a vertical line through E. Turn it round O by 90°, three times. The four lines make a square, the first half of the star at O.

The square crosses the line from O to K1 at S. Draw a circle with centre O through S. It crosses the horizontal line at F. Draw a line through F at 90° to the line from O to K1. Turn it round O by 90°, three times. The four lines make the second square of the star.
Draw a circle with centre A and the same radius. It crosses the horizontal line at P. Draw a line through P parallel to the line from O to K1. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.
Join K1, K2, K3 and K4 to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the star at O and the lines that carry the diamonds’ sides on. They close the crosses, the ten-sided pieces and the small squares.

pattern.text: Put copies of the square cell side by side. A star sits at every centre and a cross at every corner.
